title: Player-identity pilot: the played pawn is the player for its own code, off vs on (DPC 0.9.177-dev31)
intro: About 10 minutes, single player. Not blind: each pawn is played with the pilot off, then on. The pilot only lasts for this session (it goes back off at the end).

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active and tostring(D.state.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.pid: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.cfg.pawn_player_identity and 'ON' or 'off'
probes.swaps: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local P = D and D.R.pid; if not P then return '' end; local t = {}; for k, v in pairs(P.n) do if v > 0 then t[#t + 1] = k .. '=' .. v end end; table.sort(t); return table.concat(t, ' ')
probes.swaps_total: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local P = D and D.R.pid; local n = 0; for _, v in pairs(P and P.n or {}) do n = n + v end; return n
probes.off_thread: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.pid and D.R.pid.off_thread or 0
probes.hooked: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.pid and D.R.pid.hooked or 0
probes.n0: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pc = D and D.state.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc) or ''

steps.text: PLAYER-IDENTITY PILOT (not blind). Single player, co-op off, open ground, out of combat. Take control of a FIGHTER pawn (F6). Press End.
1/4 FIGHTER, PILOT OFF (as now). Three goblins that can't die appear. Fight as long as you like: attacks, skills, guard (R1) when they swing, dash. Press End to spawn them, End again when done.
Fighting, pilot off. Press End when done. Remember how guard, dash and skills felt.
2/4 FIGHTER, PILOT ON: the game now treats your pawn as the player for its own controls, movement, skills and combat. Same fight. Press End to start.

expect.label: the pawn is treated as the player in its own code

steps.text: Fighting, pilot on. Press End when done. What changed: guard / just guard, dash, skills, being hit, anything odd?
3/4 Switch to an ARCHER or MAGE pawn. PILOT OFF. Fight (aimed and hip shots, or spells with targets). Press End to spawn the goblins, End again when done.
Fighting, pilot off. Press End when done.
4/4 Same pawn, PILOT ON. Same fight. Watch what your shots / spells hit. Press End to start, End again when done.
Fighting, pilot on. Press End when done.
Done: pilot back off, goblins removed. Tell Claude what changed with the pilot on (better, worse, broken).
